peer_results.rationale: BAC candidates discuss general executive monitoring of strategic objectives and a broad risk management framework/appetite, but do not disclose specific transformation initiatives, infrastructure modernization efforts, or regulatory consent orders related to data quality similar to Citi's disclosure.

GS candidates focus on climate risk framework enhancements and Board governance of risk appetite. Neither candidate addresses Citi's specific topics of transformation, risk management infrastructure improvements, or data quality regulatory consent orders.

JPM candidates focus on Climate Risk Management function responsibilities and general risk management principles (individual responsibility, governance structure). They do not disclose the specific transformation progress, infrastructure modernization, or data quality regulatory compliance efforts detailed in Citi's disclosure.

MS candidates discuss the scope of risk management policies for business segments and the reporting structure of the Head of Non-Financial Risk. These disclosures do not cover Citi's specific transformation initiatives, infrastructure upgrades, or regulatory consent orders regarding data quality.
